conceptZh: 兔子魔術師的愛心拔河，兩顆氣球拉在一起彈成「愛」。
object: a magician rabbit and two red heart balloons
morph: two heart halves are tugged apart then spring together as 愛
creativeAngle: 兔子變出兩顆愛心氣球，各拉一邊，彈回去合成字。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a soft lilac backdrop with pale heart sparkles. Lead: a cartoon magician rabbit with a purple top hat and long ears, whose tricks backfire gently. The finished glyph 愛 is a saturated raspberry-pink, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.6s: the rabbit pulls a ribbon from his hat and a pink heart balloon floats out, splitting into two halves. First "愛" as he gasps.
1.6-3.2s: tug-of-war: he pulls the left half, the right half drifts away with his ears twisting around it; he stretches like a rubber band. Second "愛" lands as the ribbon goes taut and the halves strain.
3.2-5.0s: twang! The halves snap together, strokes sliding into place, and the glyph 愛 stands complete as the rabbit tumbles backward.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "愛心" the rabbit forms a heart with his paws and a small red heart balloon bobs up from his hat, drifting beside the glyph, his ears forming a heart shape on top.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "愛、愛、愛心" (ㄞˋ、ㄞˋ、ㄞˋ ㄒㄧㄣ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 愛.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.

conceptZh: 拉布拉多警長衝進來想把紅色愛心抱枕疊成高塔，疊到踮腳搖晃，最後把星星警徽放上去就整座倒下，抱枕滾落排成「愛」，警長被埋在旁邊只露出眼睛，再抱著一顆愛心探頭出來。
object: a big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff dog stacking plump red heart-shaped cushions into a swaying tower, topped by his own star badge
morph: the tower topples; the tumbling heart cushions squash and stretch as they land, settling into the solid red strokes of 愛 (claw top, cover, heart, sweeping legs) while a few spares bury the sheriff off to the side
creativeAngle: 改走「堆高再倒塌」的實體笑料：不再是兔子和氣球的拔河，而是警長愛心抱枕高塔倒下自然變成「愛」，字中間的「心」正好是一顆愛心抱枕，聽到「愛心」時他也真的抱著愛心探頭，聲音與畫面一致；警長被埋在字的旁邊，不遮住筆畫。
promptEn:
An 8-second 2D cartoon clip on a plain pale butter-yellow backdrop, nothing busy behind. Lead: a big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff dog, golden fur, floppy ears, a shiny star badge on his chest and a whistle on a cord, eager and clumsy. The only other things on screen are plump red heart-shaped cushions and, at the end, the single finished glyph 愛 in saturated solid cherry-red, centered, about 70% of frame height, with clean margins.

0.0-1.5s: The sheriff charges in from the left at full gallop toward a loose pile of red heart cushions, blows his whistle, and skids straight past them off the right edge. He scrambles back, plants his paws, and stares up at the pile with sparkling eyes: he wants to build the tallest heart tower ever. As he grabs the first cushion and slaps it down, the voice says the first 「愛」.

1.5-3.2s: Fast stacking. He tosses cushion on cushion, each landing with a soft squash-boing; the tower climbs past his head, past his ears. He rises onto tiptoe, tail wagging, the tower leaning left, then right, wider each time, while he dashes under it to prop it with his nose.

3.2-4.2s: One tiny extra piece: he unpins his star badge and reaches up to set it on the very top. Freeze. The tower holds for one silent beat, his grin huge. Then it tilts.

4.2-5.2s: The big topple. The whole stack comes down in a tumbling heap with cartoon squash-and-stretch. The falling cushions roll, stretch and settle into the solid red strokes of 愛, correctly formed from top to bottom: the small claw-like strokes on top, the flat cover line beneath, a plump heart 心 in the middle, and the sweeping legs at the bottom. The voice says the second 「愛」 exactly as the last stroke settles and the glyph stands complete and still. A few spare cushions bounce off into the lower-left corner and bury the sheriff, leaving only his two round eyes blinking out of the heap, well clear of the glyph.

5.2-8.0s: Hold. The glyph 愛 stays perfectly still, centered and readable. At about 6.0s the voice says 「愛心」 and the sheriff pops his head up out of the cushion heap in the lower-left corner, hugging one leftover red heart cushion to his chest with both paws, the star badge now stuck crooked on his forehead. He gives the heart a happy squeeze and a dizzy wag, never touching or covering the strokes, until the clip ends.

Audio: an off-screen voice, warm and friendly, in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, reading slowly and distinctly with clear tones exactly these syllables: 「愛、愛、愛心」 (ㄞˋ、ㄞˋ、ㄞˋ ㄒㄧㄣ). The character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. Soft cushion boings and one gentle whistle toot, all quieter than the voice. No subtitles, no vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 愛. No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
